🛑 conveyor fix — stood down, human judgment needed

conveyor fix agent stopped rather than guessing: the reviewer's finding needs a judgment the fix agent could not safely make, so it did NOT guess. Finding confirmed on main (scripts/lib/constellation-repos.mjs already has org slugs web-everything/frontier-ui/plateauapp; 13 chalbert literals vs card's 234), so the move card xvgqv8h is stale; choosing between rewriting the 356-line decision card against current state and closing it as superseded is the maintainer's call, and the security/rollback findings depend on that choice.

The PR was left EXACTLY as the reviewer left it — no label was changed, the review was not re-armed, and nothing was re-pushed. This comment is the durable record that a fixer *deliberately stood down* here, which is what tells the reconciler apart from a fixer that simply died.

**A human is the intended next step.** The automatic fix loop will NOT try this PR again while this comment stands — re-running it would only re-ask the same question. Take it over with `/finish`, or delete this comment once the blocker is resolved to hand the PR back to the loop.
